title: Mendelian randomization and transcriptomic analysis reveal a relationship between subarachnoid hemorrhage and post-translational modifications.
authors: Song, Ligang; Jiang, Ce; Huang, Mingxuan; Su, Xiaoming; Chen, Hanlin; Li, Miao; Ma, Ning; Mo, Dapeng; Sun, Xuan; Gao, Feng; Miao, Zhongrong; Chen, Xiaofeng; Su, Yanguo; Cong, Hengri; He, Hongwei; Wu, Pei; Deng, Yiming
one_liner_zh: 该文通过孟德尔随机化和转录组分析研究蛛网膜下腔出血与翻译后修饰的关系，虽涉及分子对接和MD模拟，但核心对象非蛋白质-DNA互作，仅边缘相关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Post-translational modifications (PTMs) serve as crucial regulatory mechanisms in stroke-induced brain injury. Nevertheless, the specific roles of PTMs in subarachnoid hemorrhage (SAH) development and the functional properties of associated genes are not yet fully understood. METHODS: We performed differential expression analysis on SAH dataset and intersected results with PTM-related genes to identify PTM-associated genes of SAH differential expression (DE-PTMRGs), followed by functional enrichment analysis. Mendelian randomization (MR) was applied to determine causal PTM genes affecting SAH risk. Machine learning algorithms were used to screen feature genes from these causal genes. Candidate biomarkers derived from feature gene analysis were validated using an independent transcriptomic dataset. Subsequently, these biomarkers were employed for constructing clinical diagnostic models, performing single-gene enrichment and regulatory network analyses, conducting clinical experimental validation, and predicting potential drug repurposing opportunities. RESULTS: We identified 227 SAH-associated PTM genes, of which 12 demonstrated causal relationships through Mendelian randomization analysis. Machine learning algorithms screened ZRANB1 and ATG7 as key PTM biomarkers. The diagnostic model achieved excellent performance with AUC = 0.833 (0.701-0.966), calibration curve mean error of 0.088, and capability to predict 20%-90% SAH risk. Network analysis revealed distinct regulatory patterns: ZRANB1 showed extensive connectivity with 27 microRNAs and 6 transcription factors, while ATG7 exhibited focused regulation by 16 microRNAs and 1 transcription factor. Functionally, ZRANB1 primarily regulates metabolism and genetic maintenance, while ATG7 coordinates broader cellular processes including autophagy and signal transduction. Through clinical validation, we found that the levels of ATG7 and ZRANB1 were significantly altered between SAH patients and healthy control. Both biomarkers predicted Tretinoin as a potential therapeutic compound. Molecular docking showed strong binding affinities: ZRANB1-Tretinoin (-7.7 kcal/mol) and ATG7-Tretinoin (-6.1 kcal/mol). Molecular dynamics simulations confirmed stable dynamic binding between ATG7 and Tretinoin, while ZRANB1-Tretinoin complex showed instability. CONCLUSION: The work established a novel ATG7-ZRANB1 biomarker combination with superior diagnostic accuracy for SAH prediction and identified Tretinoin as a promising therapeutic candidate, demonstrating PTM-based precision medicine potential.
abstract_zh: 背景：翻译后修饰（PTMs）在卒中诱导的脑损伤中作为关键调控机制发挥作用。然而，PTMs在蛛网膜下腔出血（SAH）发展中的具体作用及相关基因的功能特性尚未完全阐明。方法：我们对SAH数据集进行差异表达分析，并将结果与PTM相关基因取交集，以鉴定SAH差异表达的PTM相关基因（DE-PTMRGs），随后进行功能富集分析。应用孟德尔随机化（MR）确定影响SAH风险的因果PTM基因。使用机器学习算法从这些因果基因中筛选特征基因。通过独立转录组数据集验证源自特征基因分析的候选生物标志物。随后，利用这些生物标志物构建临床诊断模型、进行单基因富集和调控网络分析、开展临床实验验证，并预测潜在的药物再利用机会。结果：我们鉴定了227个SAH相关PTM基因，其中12个通过孟德尔随机化分析显示出因果关系。机器学习算法筛选出ZRANB1和ATG7作为关键PTM生物标志物。诊断模型表现出优异性能，AUC = 0.833（0.701-0.966），校准曲线平均误差为0.088，并能预测20%-90%的SAH风险。网络分析揭示了不同的调控模式：ZRANB1与27个microRNA和6个转录因子表现出广泛连接，而ATG7则受16个microRNA和1个转录因子的集中调控。在功能上，ZRANB1主要调控代谢和遗传维持，而ATG7协调更广泛的细胞过程，包括自噬和信号转导。通过临床验证，我们发现SAH患者与健康对照之间ATG7和ZRANB1的水平显著改变。两种生物标志物均预测Tretinoin为潜在治疗化合物。分子对接显示强结合亲和力：ZRANB1-Tretinoin（-7.7 kcal/mol）和ATG7-Tretinoin（-6.1 kcal/mol）。分子动力学模拟证实ATG7与Tretinoin之间具有稳定的动态结合，而ZRANB1-Tretinoin复合物则表现出不稳定性。结论：本研究建立了新型ATG7-ZRANB1生物标志物组合，对SAH预测具有优越的诊断准确性，并确定Tretinoin为有前景的治疗候选药物，展示了基于PTM的精准医学潜力。
